en.ng.same-amount.instruction: Which group has the same amount?
en.ng.same-amount.incorrect: Not the same amount. Look again.
en.ng.same-amount.hint.eliminate: This group has a different amount.
en.ng.same-amount.hint.reveal: This group has the same amount.
en.ng.glance.instruction: Take a quick look. Which group has the same amount?
en.ng.glance.hint.model: Here it is again. Take another look.
en.ng.give.incorrect: Not one for each yet. Let us count.
en.ng.give.hint.model: Count the friends. Touch them one by one.
en.ng.give.hint.step: Here are some to start with.
en.ng.give.hint.reveal: Fill every place. One for each.
en.ng.more.incorrect: That group has fewer. Look again.
en.ng.fewer.incorrect: That group has more. Look again.
en.ng.equal.instruction: Find the two groups with the same amount.
en.ng.equal.incorrect: Those are not equal. Look again.

skills.title: Match small groups by amount
skills.objective: Sees that two groups of up to three things have the same amount, even when the things and how they are laid out are different. No numerals and no counting words are needed.

skills.title: See small amounts at a glance
skills.objective: Sees how many are in a group of up to four when it is shown only for a moment, without counting one by one, and matches it to a group of the same amount.

skills.title: Give one for each, up to five
skills.objective: Gives out exactly as many things as there are friends, up to five, one for each, and stops there without places to fill.

skills.title: Give one for each, up to ten
skills.objective: Gives out exactly as many things as there are friends, from six to ten, keeping count of how many have been given.

skills.title: Find which group has more
skills.objective: Picks the group with more out of two or three groups of up to six, including when the smaller group is made of bigger things.

skills.title: Find which group has fewer
skills.objective: Picks the group with fewer out of two or three groups of up to six, including when the larger group is made of smaller things.

skills.title: Find two groups that are equal
skills.objective: Out of three or four groups of up to six, finds the two that have the same amount, whatever they are made of and however they are laid out.

lessons.title: Same amount, up to three
lessons.summary: The guide shows one example, then your child matches groups of one, two and three things by how many there are.

lessons.title: How many, at a glance
lessons.summary: A small group is shown for a moment and then covered. Your child finds the group with the same amount, by seeing how many there were rather than counting.

lessons.title: One for each, up to five
lessons.summary: Some friends each want one thing. Your child gives out exactly enough, one for each, and says when they are done. With help each friend has a place to fill; then there are no places and your child keeps count.

lessons.title: One for each, up to ten
lessons.summary: The same game with more friends, six to ten of them, often standing five to a line the way two hands hold ten. Your child gives one to each and keeps count.

lessons.title: Which has more?
lessons.summary: Two or three groups of up to six things. Your child finds the one with more. Sometimes the smaller group is drawn with bigger things, so that more has to mean how many, not how much room.

lessons.title: Which has fewer?
lessons.summary: Two or three groups of up to six things. Your child finds the one with fewer. Sometimes the larger group is drawn with smaller things, so that fewer has to mean how many.

lessons.title: Two that are equal
lessons.summary: Three or four groups, and two of them have the same amount. Your child picks out those two. The things and the way they are laid out differ, so the only way is to compare how many.
